export.readme:
zvena data export

account.json — profile, sign-in methods, consent, workspaces and roles.
security-log.json — the account's security journal.
documents/ — documents of workspaces where you are owner or editor: documents.json (zvena format, importable) and pages as Markdown.
projects/ — issues, projects and cycles of your workspaces: projects.json and issues.csv.
files/ — uploaded files.
design/ — designs as .penpot files (import into Design or Penpot).
export.disabled: The workspace owner has disabled exporting its documents.
export.designMissing: Design was unavailable during the export. Please try again later.
signout.title: Sign out of zvena?
signout.fromDesign: You signed out of Design. To sign out of your zvena account on this device too, press the button.
brand.tagline: The free workspace for design, docs and projects
landing.lead: zvena brings a professional interface design tool and powerful docs with databases into one place — with one team and one set of roles. Free for everyone.
landing.terms: By continuing, you agree to the {terms} and acknowledge the {privacy}.
signin.title: Sign in to zvena
signin.lead: Sign in or create an account — no password needed.
signin.terms: By continuing, you agree to the {terms} and acknowledge the {privacy}.
signin.dev: Sign in as a test user
signin.failed: We couldn't sign you in. Please try again.
signin.state: Your sign-in session expired. Please try again.
signin.provider: This sign-in method isn't available right now.
signin.blocked: This account is blocked. Please contact support.
signin.consentRequired: Please sign in again to accept the updated Terms.
signin.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
signin.emailTooMany: Too many sign-in emails to this address. Please wait an hour or use another method.
signin.emailFailed: We couldn't send the email. Please try again or use another method.
signin.emailExpired: This sign-in link has expired or was already used. Please request a new one.
signin.testStand: This is a test stand with test data only.
checkEmail.title: Check your inbox
checkEmail.lead: We sent a sign-in link and a 6-digit code to {email}.
checkEmail.wrongCode: That code isn't right. Check the latest email and try again.
checkEmail.hint: Didn't get it? Check your spam folder or request a new email.
checkEmail.expired: This sign-in request has expired. Please request a new link.
emailLink.title: Sign in to zvena
emailLink.expiredLead: Sign-in links work once and expire after 15 minutes.
consent.title: We've updated our Terms
consent.lead: Our Terms of Service or Privacy Policy changed (effective {date}). Please review them to continue.
home.myIssuesEmpty: Nothing is assigned to you. Issues assigned to you show up here.
home.setupProjects: Plan work with issues and projects — they link to your docs and designs.
home.guestBanner: You are working without an account: docs stay in this browser only, and uploaded files are deleted after {days} days without a visit. Sign in to keep everything.
home.guestWarn: Your uploaded files will be deleted on {date} unless you sign in.
ws.name: Name
ws.deleteConfirm: Delete the workspace “{name}” with all its docs and designs? This cannot be undone.
ws.leaveConfirm: Leave “{name}”? You can only come back with a new invite.
ws.inviteOnce: The link is shown once. Valid for {days} days, up to {uses} people.
ws.role.editor.hint: Creates and edits docs and designs
ws.personalNote: Only you see your personal workspace. To work together, create a shared workspace.
ws.readOnly: Your role is “{role}”: editing is off.
join.title: Invitation to “{name}”
join.invalid: This link is not valid: it was revoked, expired or ran out of places.
pageInvite.title: You're invited to “{title}”
pageInvite.lead: In {ws}. Access: {level}. You'll see this page and the pages inside it only.
pageInvite.signin: Sign in to open the page
settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name
welcome.title: Welcome to zvena
welcome.name.title: What should we call you?
welcome.name.lead: zvena will greet you by this name, and your team will see it next to your work.
welcome.name.label: Your name
welcome.theme.title: Choose your look
welcome.theme.lead: You can change it any time in Settings.
welcome.team.title: Who will you work with?
welcome.team.lead: A team keeps its docs, projects and designs in one shared workspace.
welcome.team.soloHint: Start in your personal workspace. You can start a team any time.
welcome.team.withHint: Create a shared workspace and invite people to it.
welcome.team.limit: You already have as many workspaces as your plan allows.
welcome.invite.title: Invite your team
welcome.invite.lead: The people you invite get a link to join “{ws}”.
welcome.done.title: You’re all set, {name}
welcome.done.lead: Two things that make zvena fast:
welcome.done.palette: Find anything, go anywhere, create anything
welcome.done.create: Create a doc, an issue or a design in one click from Home
settings.exportHint: A ZIP archive: docs (JSON and Markdown), uploaded files, designs as .penpot files and account data.
settings.deleteHint: This deletes the account, the personal workspace, your shared workspaces (if nobody else is in them — otherwise ownership passes to the next member), docs, files and designs. This cannot be undone.
settings.appsHint: Web Clippers connected to your account. Each one can only see the names of your pages and add new ones.
settings.appsNone: No Web Clipper is connected. Install it in your browser and press Connect in it.
clipper.name: zvena Web Clipper
clipper.connect.title: Connect the Web Clipper
clipper.connect.lead: {app} wants to save pages to your zvena account.
clipper.connect.can1: see the names of the pages and databases you can edit
clipper.connect.cannot: It can't read what your pages say, change them or delete anything. You can disconnect it at any time in Settings.
clipper.connect.bad: This connection link is incomplete or has expired. Start again in the extension: press Connect.
clipper.connected.title: Web Clipper connected
clipper.connected.lead: You can close this tab and save pages from the extension.
clipper.connected.deniedLead: The Web Clipper was not connected. You can close this tab.
clipper.connected.noExtension: The extension did not answer. Make sure the zvena Web Clipper is installed and turned on, then press Connect in it again.
clip.title: Save to zvena
clip.privateHint: A new page in your Private section
clip.empty: Nothing to save yet: add a link or some text.
clip.error.forbidden: You can't add pages there. Pick another place.
clip.error.notFound: That page is gone. Pick another place.
clip.error.tooLarge: This is too large to save.
clip.error.rate: Too many saves in a row. Please try again in a minute.
clip.error.offline: You're offline. Connect to the internet and try again.
pwa.offlineLead: This page isn't saved on this device. Docs you opened recently work without the internet.
pageError.title: Something went wrong
pageError.body: This page couldn’t load. Your work is saved; try again in a moment.
templates.title: Templates
templates.lead: Ready-made docs and designs: pick one and start from it.
dtpl.landing.name: Landing page
dtpl.landing.description: Hero, features, pricing, testimonials and footer — desktop and phone.
dtpl.mobileApp.name: Mobile app
dtpl.mobileApp.description: Sign-in, feed, detail, profile and settings with a tab bar.
dtpl.uiKit.name: UI kit
dtpl.uiKit.description: Colors, type, buttons, inputs, toggles, cards and alerts.
report.title: Report content
report.lead: Tell us what is wrong. A moderator will review it and take it down if it breaks the rules.
admin.title: Reports
cookie.text: zvena uses only essential cookies — no ads, no analytics.
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.draft: Draft — to be checked by a lawyer
settings.ownerOnly: Only workspace owners can see and change these settings.
settings.security.lead: Control how content leaves {workspace} and who can join it.
settings.security.publishHint: No one can publish pages or open public form links. Pages already published stop being served until this is turned off.
settings.security.guestsHint: Pages can't be shared with people outside the workspace: no page invite links and no email invites to outsiders.
settings.security.exportHint: Members' data exports leave this workspace's documents and issues out. Owners can still export.
settings.security.move: Disable moving pages to other workspaces
settings.security.moveHint: No one can move pages from this workspace to another one.
settings.security.inviteHint: Editors can invite people to the workspace too. When off, only owners can.
settings.security.joinRole: Role for people who join by email domain
settings.security.joinRoleHint: Given to people with an allowed email domain who join after signing in (Identity → Verified domains).
settings.identity.lead: Verify your company's domains, set up single sign-on and provision people from your identity provider.
settings.identity.sharedOnly: Identity settings are for shared workspaces. Create a team workspace to use them.
settings.domains.title: Verified domains
settings.domains.hint: Prove that your company owns a domain by adding a TXT record to its DNS.
settings.domains.record: Add this TXT record to {domain}, then press Verify:
settings.domains.allowJoinHint: Anyone with a verified email address at this domain can join the workspace when they sign in.
settings.domains.errRecord: The record wasn't found yet. DNS changes can take a while to appear — try again in a few minutes.
settings.domains.errTaken: Another workspace has already verified this domain.
settings.domains.errDns: The DNS lookup failed. Try again in a minute.
settings.domains.errInvalid: Enter a domain name like example.com.
settings.sso.title: Single sign-on (SSO)
settings.sso.hint: People at your verified domains sign in through your identity provider: Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, OneLogin and others.
settings.sso.sp: Enter these in your identity provider
settings.sso.idpMetadataHint: Paste the metadata XML or upload the file — or fill in the three fields below instead.
settings.sso.secretKept: Leave empty to keep the saved secret
settings.sso.enabledHint: People at your verified domains can choose “Continue with SSO” on the sign-in page.
settings.sso.enforcedHint: People at your verified domains can sign in only through SSO. Workspace owners can still use other methods, so you never get locked out.
settings.sso.jitHint: Someone who signs in through SSO for the first time joins the workspace (just-in-time provisioning).
settings.sso.idpInitiated: Allow sign-in from the identity provider's dashboard
settings.sso.idpInitiatedHint: Accept IdP-initiated logins. Less safe than starting from zvena: turn it on only if your team needs it.
settings.sso.removeConfirm: Remove single sign-on? People will sign in with their other methods.
settings.sso.needDomain: Verify a domain first to require SSO.
settings.scim.title: SCIM provisioning
settings.scim.hint: Let your identity provider add, update and remove members and groups automatically.
settings.scim.tokenOnce: Copy this token now — you won't be able to see it again.
settings.scim.domainsNote: People are provisioned at your verified domains only.
settings.audit.lead: Security events in this workspace: sign-ins, members, sharing, settings and more.
settings.audit.ev.domain.join.on: Let people with the domain join
settings.audit.ev.domain.join.off: Stopped people with the domain joining
settings.audit.ev.integration.connect: Connected a page to an integration
settings.audit.ev.integration.disconnect: Disconnected a page from an integration
settings.audit.ev.page.grant.group: Shared a page with a group
settings.audit.ev.page.invite.accept: Opened a page by its invite link
settings.audit.ev.page.invite.mail: Invited someone to a page by email
settings.audit.ev.page.move.workspace: Moved a page to another workspace
settings.audit.ev.page.publish: Published a page to the web
settings.audit.ev.page.revoke: Removed someone's access to a page
settings.audit.ev.page.revoke.group: Removed a group's access to a page
settings.audit.ev.sso.reject: A single sign-on attempt was refused
settings.audit.ev.teamspace.group: Added a group to a teamspace
settings.audit.ev.teamspace.group.remove: Removed a group from a teamspace
settings.guests.lead: People outside this workspace who were given pages of it. Removing a guest takes away every page here they could open.
settings.guests.confirm: Remove {name} from every page of this workspace?
settings.guests.empty: No guests: no page here is shared with anyone outside the workspace.
settings.analytics.lead: How people use this workspace: who was active, which pages are read and edited. Someone who turned off their page view history shows no views.
settings.analytics.empty: No page was opened or edited in this period.
settings.sites.lead: Give a published site its own address, like docs.example.com.
settings.sites.empty: Publish a page to the web first, then connect a domain to it here.
settings.sites.dns: Add one of these records at your DNS provider, then press Verify:
settings.sites.cname: CNAME — for a subdomain such as docs.example.com
settings.sites.txt: TXT — for a root domain (point its A record to zvena too)
settings.sites.name: Name
settings.sites.errInUse: This domain is connected to another site.
settings.sites.errOneDomain: This site already has a domain.
signin.ssoLead: Enter your work email. We'll take you to your company's sign-in page.
signin.ssoRequired: Your organization requires signing in with SSO.
signin.ssoFailed: Single sign-on didn't work. Try again, or ask your workspace owner.
signin.ssoUnknown: SSO isn't set up for this email domain.
signin.ssoDomain: Your identity provider can't sign in this address.
signin.ssoNotMember: Ask a workspace owner to add you: this workspace doesn't add new people automatically.
signin.ssoLimit: This workspace has reached its member limit.
joinDomain.title: Join your team
joinDomain.lead: Your email address lets you join these workspaces:
joinDomain.none: There are no workspaces to join with your email domain.
